svg.title: How the site is served
svg.desc: Flow diagram of how birchdesignlab.com is served. Page requests go to Cloudflare Static Assets, which serves the built site or its 404 page, while form and beacon posts go to the Worker, which checks a honeypot, a rate limit, validation and a daily cap before sending email and holds failed sends in KV for a daily cron to retry.

text.tspan: 303 to the sent page, root or
